rationale: The stock has already gapped down ~16.6% and is sitting at the absolute low of the day with 27 minutes to close, showing a steady 5-candle downtrend with declining price and rising volume — a continuation short is tempting but the ATR is only $0.045 on 5-minute bars, making meaningful risk/reward nearly impossible to structure.
